text:
Sam (Sales): FinTech X wants a 14-day pilot: EU-only data plane, BYOK, and a dated subprocessor snapshot. They also want confirmation that no non-EU subprocessors will touch request payloads. Can ops & security scope?
Priya (SE): Quick Q: control plane ok if it's metadata-only? Also do they require log traces to remain in EU?
Sam (Sales): Legal said control plane metadata is ok. Logs/traces/payloads must stay in EU for the pilot.
Vik (Ops): We can pin tenant to eu-west-1 and restrict routing to EU pools. BYOK via our KMS connector in eu-west-1 is supported. BYO-HSM is out of scope for a 2-week pilot. Need check on model variants present in EU pools; some optimized variants are global-only.
Nadia (Security): I'll prepare the SCQ responses and a POC attestation stating subprocessors during the pilot window and the EU-only retention guarantee. Ops please confirm observability endpoints and whether we can enable per-tenant export to EU-only sinks and redaction.
Clara (Pricing): Note: single-region pin + BYOK + reserved capacity increases cost. Ballpark two-week delta:  ~  (I'll post concrete numbers after we pick pool size).
Priya (SE): Proposed POC scope:
- duration: 14 days
- tenancy: pin to eu-west-1 (eu-central warm standby inside EU)
- kms: customer-managed key ARN -> map via KMS connector
- subprocessors: ops to provide dated CSV snapshot for pilot dates
- routing: strict_residency=true, fallback=queue_notify; no automatic cross-border failover
- observability: EU-only export + trace redaction enabled for tenant
Vik (Ops): Implementation notes:
```
tenant_id: fintechx-poc-2026
residency: EU
primary_pool: eu-west-1
standby_pool: eu-central-1
models: prefer EU-hosted quant variants, fallback to same-family within EU
kms: external_key_arn -> mapped
routing: strict_residency=true
fallback: queue_notify
observability_sink: obs-eu.redwood
trace_redaction: enabled
```
Vik (Ops): Important: strict_residency=true constrains autoscale to EU capacity. If pool is saturated we will queue or return 429 unless a manual failover is approved. We'll provide a manual failover playbook and contact list.
Nadia (Security): Add 24h notice clause to attestation for any cross-border manual failover during POC. Ops confirm you can provide a daily subprocessor snapshot for the pilot window.
Vik (Ops): Confirmed: can flip observability exports to obs-eu.redwood for this tenant and produce dated subprocessor CSV for the interval. Will schedule config change in a short maintenance window.
Clara (Pricing): I'll prepare two quotes (minimal reserved pool vs higher reserved pool) and include BYOK connector + eng support. Rough external estimate to share tomorrow.
Priya (SE): I'll prepare a short eval harness and sample prompts so the customer can compare quality/latency differences for EU-hosted variants vs our global defaults. We'll include guidance in the packet.
ci-bot: residency-pin apply requested for tenant fintechx-poc-2026 -> job#9721 queued
Sam (Sales): Action items summary: Priya draft tech packet + eval harness. Vik provide subprocessor snapshot, confirm model availability, and schedule config push. Nadia finalize attestation & SCQ. Clara post quotes. I'll send the packet to customer after pieces are in.
Sam (Sales): Target to deliver to customer tomorrow AM. Thanks team :thumbsup:
